name: 11234-loraprefill-7b-1gpu
model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf, served with the LoRA adapter yard1/llama-2-7b-sql-lora-test (rank 8) attached to every request
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rates 30 then 60 req/s back to back on one engine; warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, each bounded at 1500 requests with a 900 s safety cap. Rate 30 is the scored point.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`: 128 prompt tokens in, 32 tokens out, one turn, min == max == mean on both lengths. Prompts are drawn fresh per request and share no prefix. Every request is routed to the LoRA adapter named in `scenario.json: spec.backend.lora_modules`; there is no un-adapted traffic in the mix.
purpose: A SQL assistant on a 7B model with a LoRA adapter, serving short single-turn requests at 30–60 per second on one GPU.
launch:
# The serve command for this workload. Nothing is tuned.
# vLLM 0.6.6.post1-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.

model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-lora: true
max-loras: 3
max-cpu-loras: 15
max-lora-rank: 8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
enable-prefix-caching: false
